stem:
The chef at a restaurant makes 6 burritos with every 1 pound of meat.

Which table shows the relationship between burritos and pounds of meat?

options.label: A
options.text:
Number of Burritos | Pounds of Meat
7 | 1
8 | 2
16 | 10
20 | 14

options.label: B
options.text:
Number of Burritos | Pounds of Meat
6 | 1
12 | 2
60 | 10
84 | 14

options.label: C
options.text:
Number of Burritos | Pounds of Meat
1 | 6
2 | 12
10 | 60
14 | 84

options.label: D
options.text:
Number of Burritos | Pounds of Meat
6 | 1
12 | 7
18 | 13
24 | 19

visual_elements: Tables labeled A, B, C, D showing number of burritos and pounds of meat
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding and applying a ratio to find the correct relationship from multiple tables.
